future_perturbation_invariance.description: Observable computation does not use future information
future_perturbation_invariance.method: All observables computed using only data available at time t or earlier
future_perturbation_invariance.details: DMD window uses only past 720 slots; K2/K3/K4 use only current and past observations

truncation_invariance.method: Compare full-sample results with truncated sample (removing last 2000 slots)
truncation_invariance.details: Inherited from B3 truncation audit (bit-exact match verified)

prefix_consistency.method: Observable at time t does not change when data after t is added
prefix_consistency.details: All observables are rolling/recursive and do not depend on future data

deterministic_rerun.method: Run pipeline twice, compare numeric ledger hashes
deterministic_rerun.details: Inherited from B3 determinism audit (sha256 match verified)

development_only_guard.details: ProtectedPartitionError raised if non-DEVELOPMENT partition requested

notes: B5 inherits causality guarantees from B3
Future outcome computation uses shift(-h) which is correctly aligned
No data leakage detected in observable extraction
